defaults.backend: complete: clean-room local exposure-event adapters for 14 documented provider paths (Amplitude, CleverTap, Custom, Firebase, Freshpaint, FullStory, Heap, Jitsu, Keen IO, Langfuse, mParticle, Arize Phoenix, Segment, Snowplow) normalise caller payloads into one workspace-scoped exposure shape with deterministic retry deduplication, a local rejection log, custom dotted-path field mappings and per-provider statistics
defaults.frontend: complete: dedicated experiment-exposure Operations route renders the 14 provider catalog with offline samples, configured trackers with confirm-gated disable, field mapping, single/batch ingestion, normalised exposures, rejection and batch audit tables; static guard in test_ui_wiring.py
defaults.database: complete: five additive workspace-scoped tables created by migration d9e1f2a3b4c5 (exposure_trackers, exposure_field_mappings, normalized_exposures, exposure_rejections, exposure_batches), with dedupe constraints for tracker/provider and event id; no existing table altered
defaults.api: complete: one stable experiment-exposure API group (version 1, no legacy claim, external_calls=false, external_delivery=false, vendor_sdk_used=false, generated_by=local-adapter) covering provider catalog/samples, tracker config, mappings, single and batch ingestion, exposures, stats, rejections and batches
defaults.permissions: complete: verify_workspace plus require(CONTACT_READ) for reads and require(NOTE_WRITE) for all writes; tracker ids from other workspaces fail closed with 404; every configuration and ingestion mutation publishes an audited event
defaults.integration: complete: publishes normalised exposures to NOVARA's shared event spine (experiment.exposure_recorded) with local idempotency keys; no vendor SDK, hosted API, browser snippet, outbound network or upstream source is contacted or copied
defaults.criteria: Nineteen named acceptance tests plus a UI guard prove each provider's documented exposure payload maps to the shared local event spine with socket.connect patched to fail, retries deduplicate, invalid payloads are logged, batches account for every item, custom mappings validate, configuration fails closed and workspaces are isolated.
defaults.remaining: No remaining work for the recorded local acceptance criteria. Vendor SDKs, hosted endpoints, browser snippets, outbound delivery and real analytics destinations remain out of scope and are not claimed.
